items.html:
MY Leaders Lab

Join MY Wellness Warriors​

 

The MY Wellness Summer Program 2026 is a unique leadership opportunity for Muslim college students/young adults who want to support youth wellness and mental health in their communities. As a Youth Intern, you will not only gain valuable mentorship and training, but also actively help facilitate workshops, support program sessions, and take part in leading community-based initiatives.

​

Youth Interns will work closely with field professionals, community leaders, and faith-based organizations, and will play a key role in helping organize and support a culminating Youth Wellness Symposium attended by families, organizations, and local leaders, as well as the Wellness Warriors—the younger youth participants who will be presenting their work and projects at the event.

items.html:
MY Leaders Lab 

Join Climate Justice Warriors​​

A hands-on climate action team by MY Project USA!

​

Climate Justice Warriors is a youth-led environmental initiative of MY Project USA’s MY Leaders Lab. Volunteers help reduce waste and promote sustainability by sorting, reusing, refurbishing, recycling, and preparing donated items for community use through our warehouse operations.

​

Participants gain hands-on experience in environmental stewardship, leadership, teamwork, community service, and thrift retail operations while helping build a cleaner, more sustainable future. Volunteers of all ages are welcome, with a special focus on developing youth leaders ages 14–18. 

​

Volunteer with MY Project USA through youth leadership, food access, community health, environmental action, gardens and other service opportunities. Each listing should clearly state eligibility and current needs.

items.html:
Hilltop Free Clinic

Cancer Screening & Prevention Initiative​

Join a community-driven effort to advance cancer prevention and health equity.

​

Supported by the McKesson Foundation, this summer initiative brings together medical students, undergraduate students, healthcare professionals, medical interpreters, and community volunteers to expand cancer prevention, education, outreach, and screening services for underserved communities in Columbus.

​

Volunteers gain valuable experience in public health, community engagement, patient education, leadership, and healthcare outreach while making a meaningful impact in the community.

items.html:
Hilltop Free Clinic 

Join the Hilltop Free Clinic Team​

Be part of a mission-driven healthcare team.

​

Hilltop Free Clinic is an initiative of MY Project USA providing free preventive screenings and primary care services to uninsured and underinsured individuals in the Hilltop community of Columbus, Ohio. Since 2023, the clinic has been operated by medical students and undergraduate volunteers under the supervision of licensed volunteer physicians.

​

Volunteers gain hands-on experience in clinical care, community health outreach, leadership, research, patient advocacy, and clinic operations while helping advance health equity in underserved communities. Students also have opportunities to participate in cancer and diabetes prevention initiatives, community-based health programs, and mobile health outreach efforts launching throughout Columbus neighborhoods.

​

We welcome medical students, undergrads and healthcare professionals who are passionate about service, healthcare, public health, research, and community engagement. Applications are accepted year-round.

items.html:
Hilltop Youth Garden

Volunteer at the Hilltop Youth Garden ​​
​

Join us in empowering local youth and nurturing our community through the Hilltop Youth Garden! Volunteers will work alongside young leaders to grow fresh produce, learn about sustainable gardening, and create a safe, positive space for learning and growth. Whether you have a green thumb or just a passion for helping others, your time and energy can make a lasting impact. Get involved today - grow food, grow futures!​​
